_comment: Arm settings for motion.py. Lift in mm of carriage travel, base in degrees of yaw (CAD: 0 = boom along +X, positive = counterclockwise from above). gear_ratio = motor degrees per unit. Taught pockets and measured travel live in config/taught.json on the Pi (TEACH / CALIBRATE).
_joints: lift: rack and pinion, 20T m1.2 pinion = 75.40 mm per motor turn (360/75.40 = 4.7746). It backdrives when the motor lets go, so its stall protection stays OFF (a trip releases the shaft). base: motor drives the turntable 1:1 through the B06 adapter; the 0.3 mm tab play is taken up by always finishing a move turning the 'approach' way. dir_bit_positive: CHECK on the arm (jog lift +5 must go UP, jog base +5 must turn counterclockwise from above).
_homing: hard_stop = drive slowly into the stop until the motor lags (Surya's seek), then that spot is stop_at. marked_zero = the arm is parked at marked_at when motion starts. The lift has no clear spot to go all the way down (the jaws always meet a platform), so it seeks UP to its solid top stop, nominally 70 mm (CAD stroke). The base seeks its clockwise stop; its measured stop-to-stop range is 158.6 deg, so stop_at = -79.3. calibrate_both_ends re-measures the base range (CALIBRATE).
_poses: Pockets default to the CAD docks (145 mm radius): A -60, B -20, OUT +20, C +60 deg; lift heights are placeholders until taught. Vision box N = pocket N; TEACH overrides these in taught.json. travel_lift must clear the dock platforms while the base turns.
